rows.grounds: compound of vaktra (mouth), aṅga (limb), and ādi (etc.)
śiva plus anta (end), accusative singular masculine

items.question: Which beings are included from mouth-limbs to Śiva?
premises: Men and women are both named.
items.inference: The range from mouth-limbs to Śiva includes men and women.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of puṃsaḥ and striyaḥ remains unclear.
items.plain_english: From mouth-limbs up to Śiva, men and women.
